formula: P(home) = Phi(a(tau) * lead / sqrt(tau) + b(tau) * mu * sqrt(tau)); a, b piecewise linear in tau on knots; mu = -(home spread); tau = share of regulation left (in overtime, the period's time left / 48 min)
fit: 2015-16..2025-26 (no 2019-20), 12095 games of ESPN play-by-play with archived pregame lines
source: Copied from Dave356w/nba-matchups model/live_wp.json (research/live_wp.py) at the owner's request, 11 November 2026
note: Display only. Never a scoring feature, forecast, selection, grade or training input of the Sleeper model.
